Project details
Nova Fluid Type
Fluid type scale for the Nova component library
LitViteTypeScript

Replaces the breakpoint jumps in the type scale with clamp() values for all nine steps. Old token names stay as aliases for one release, so product teams can switch at their own pace.

Next steps

  • Generate the nine steps for 320 to 1200 px
  • Check text zoom at 200 % (WCAG 1.4.4)
  • Write the migration note for product teams

Decisions

  • Line heights stay unitless
  • Two scales: 1.1 on mobile, 1.2 on desktop

About this project & agents

Project Dashboard

All projects at a glance

with status, tasks and connections

One HTML file, no server, no account. It shows what is being worked on, what comes next and where projects can learn from each other. Claude Code and three agents keep the numbers, the status and the synergies up to date.

How the dashboard is made

What it does

Project overview

Every project with phase, last change and links, grouped by organization. Column sets show only what you need right now.

Search with filters

Finds projects, tasks, memory and notes. With person:, tag: or -word the search becomes a precise filter.

Project details

One card per project: summary, facts, status, next steps and all documents to open or copy.

Tasks

Tickets as Markdown files, optionally managed in Obsidian. Check them off here; overdue dates stand out.

Synergies

An agent finds connections between projects and says what you get from them and what the next step is.

Skills and shortcuts

Every skill with its purpose; a graph shows who calls whom. Shortcuts such as +lg or +rl start whole routines.

Ideas

Ideas get a card before they turn into a project.

Design system

Built on Kernmix, a remix of the open standard KERN: light and dark, measured contrast, square corners.

GitHub

Three agents keep it current

Nobody updates numbers, documents and synergies by hand. Three agents in Claude Code do it: one measures, one compares, one coordinates and applies the result.

Cockpit
Coordinates and applies
Session model

Starts Radar and Bridge, checks their results and applies them to the dashboard. Develops the page further.

Result: a verified, current dashboard.

How to start it

claude --agent cockpit in the dashboard folder
Radar
Measures the status
Sonnet

Reads all project folders: files, lines, last change, hours, CLAUDE.md and memory. From that it updates the overview, document tables and inventory.

Result: current numbers and hints about missing or outdated notes.

How to start it

in a session: “Let Radar scan all projects.”
Bridge
Finds connections
Opus

Compares project content, such as tokens, components and decisions, and spots where a solution helps elsewhere too.

Result: Synergy cards with benefit and next step, plus suggestions for the tasks.

How to start it

in a session: “Let Bridge look for synergies.”

How they work together

1. You start Cockpit

With claude --agent cockpit starts a session in which Cockpit is in charge.

2. Radar and Bridge work in parallel

Cockpit briefs both. Radar measures with the fast model Sonnet, Bridge compares with the thorough model Opus.

3. Cockpit checks and applies

Results are checked before they reach the dashboard. After that, numbers, documents and synergies are right again.

Good to know

AgentModelMayDelivers
Cockpitsame as the sessionstart Radar and Bridge, read and change files, run commandsverified dashboard
RadarSonnetread, search, run commands, change existing filesnumbers, document tables, inventory
BridgeOpusread, search, run commands, change existing filessynergy cards, suggestions

Radar and Bridge cannot start other agents; only Cockpit can. For a quick run, ask Radar or Bridge directly in a session. The agents live in ~/.claude/agents/.

Who calls whom 15 Skills · 13 links

From left to right: entry points (nothing calls them), brokers and helpers (called and calling; helpers sit closer to the building blocks), building blocks (call nothing). Click a category to highlight its skills; the color strip shows the category. Click (or Tab and Enter) a skill to pin it: calls, called by, listed below with a link to the card. Click again or press Esc to release. Dashed = asks you first.

callsasks you first3called by 3 skills

Legend

Columns
From left to right: you start entry points yourself, no other skill calls them. Brokers and helpers are called and call others; helpers sit closer to the building blocks. Building blocks do one thing and call nothing.
Arrows
solid: the skill calls the other one (arrowhead at the called skill). dashed: it asks you first. Arcs that loop back on the right point to a skill in the same or a column further left.
Highlight
After clicking a skill: accent color = it calls these, orange = called by these. After clicking a category: its skills and their connections.

how many skills call this one.

Synergies & collaboration

One fluid type approach for two systems

Three projects move to fluid type at the same time. The clamp() math, the test page and the migration note can be shared.

What you get: Each team saves the setup work, and the scales stay comparable.

Next step: Turn the Nova test page into a shared tool.
